location_exception_reason: Office cabin design and fit-out is a location-dependent service; buyers explicitly search by geography (e.g., 'office cabin designing in Bengaluru', 'site office cabin Delhi') because service delivery, site visits, and installation logistics are tied to seller location. Location in title aids buyer discovery and sets correct service-area expectations.
biz_exception_reason: Titles containing 'Designer', 'Contractor', 'Manufacturer', or 'Service Provider' materially change buyer intent — a buyer searching 'office cabin designer' expects design consultation, while 'office cabin manufacturer' signals prefab structural supply. The business-type word disambiguates the service model, not merely the seller category.
